description: This Java class implements a simple field expression used within a query framework, providing methods for visitor acceptance, equality, and string representation.

classes.name: SimpleFieldExpressionImpl
classes.description: A concrete implementation of various field expression interfaces representing a simple field for querying purposes.

methods.name: SimpleFieldExpressionImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the object with a non-null field name.

methods.name: acceptFilterVisitor
methods.description: Accepts a filter visitor to perform operations based on field expression.

methods.name: acceptExistsVisitor
methods.description: Accepts an exists visitor for visiting the expression.

methods.name: acceptSortVisitor
methods.description: Accepts a sort visitor for visiting the expression.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a general field expression visitor.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on field name.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on class and field name.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
